answer: Give every agent a comet streak bond: a deposit tied to one unbroken streak of honest epochs, burned if the streak breaks. To claim a job, the agent must answer a lantern beacon, a live challenge lit at a random time demanding fresh proof of its own ongoing work within minutes, so one operator cannot answer for many clones at once. Payouts pass through a harbor gate opening once per epoch that caps total payout per operator cluster. A fleet of n clones pays n full bonds and n live proofs but shares one capped harbor payout, so cost grows with n while revenue per clone falls as 1/n.
